Frontend login redirects in ~0.3s, Fundle badge visible on /login and sidebar. No CORS blocks on dashboard/calculations/masters/insights/recovery endpoints.

action_items: Optional: fix Recharts container dimensions warning on Overview dashboard (add minHeight or aspect ratio)
critical_code_review_comments: CORS regex '.*' + allow_credentials=true means any site can send authenticated requests to the API. For a finance app this is a security concern — recommend restricting CORS_ORIGINS env var to an explicit allowlist in production (fundlezone.com + preview URL).
set_cookie has secure=False (server.py line 143) — cookies work on HTTP but should be secure=True in production (https). Consider driving from env var.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded admin user
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend at localhost:8001 is authoritative for CORS testing (Cloudflare on preview strips headers). Test file /app/backend/tests/test_login_cors_regression.py covers preflight, login speed, concurrent logins, cold-start seed, and downstream authenticated endpoints. Reuse for regression.
